_note: Approved business definitions. The planner must use these when a term matches. Terms marked ambiguous make the agent ask which definition is meant instead of picking one. New terms arrive through the glossary-proposal approval flow.

revenue.definition: Sum of orders.total_amount for orders whose status is not 'cancelled', dated by orders.order_date.
revenue.sql_hint: SUM(o.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled')  -- or WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'; period on o.order_date

order count.definition: Count of orders whose status is not 'cancelled', dated by order_date. A status breakdown counts every status.

average order value.definition: Revenue divided by order count (non-cancelled orders), rounded to cents.

units sold.definition: Sum of order_items.quantity on non-cancelled orders, dated by orders.order_date.
units sold.sql_hint: SUM(i.quantity) joining orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

new customers.definition: Customers whose customers.created_at falls in the period.
new customers.sql_hint: COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE created_at >= :start AND created_at < :end

candidates.label: Ordered in the last 90 days (sales operations definition)
candidates.sql_hint: COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date > :as_of - 90 AND o.order_date <= :as_of

candidates.label: Ordered in the last 12 months (finance definition)
candidates.sql_hint: COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_date > :as_of - INTERVAL '12 months' AND o.order_date <= :as_of

fiscal year.definition: FY2026 runs 1 February 2026 to 31 January 2027 (FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH=2). 'This year' and 'last year' are ambiguous between calendar and fiscal, so the agent asks.

unsupported._note: Concepts the schema cannot answer. The agent declines and says what it does have, instead of inventing a proxy.
